definition.simple: A large farming tool with sharp blades that gets pulled through dirt to break it up and turn it over.
definition.academic: A large farming implement with one or more blades fixed in a frame, drawn over soil to turn it over and cut furrows in preparation for the planting of seeds.

examples: A traditional wooden plough pulled by a pair of oxen in a village.
A modern multi-blade iron plough attached to the back of a tractor.

common_misconceptions: Ploughs are only made of wood.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Explain how ancient humans invented the plough to grow more food with less effort.
